summary: You can now run the suite with no public exposure, inside your own network.

new.title: Install inside your own private network
new.text: You can now install the suite inside your own virtual network, with no public address for the web app or its data. Sign-in still goes through Microsoft Entra.

new.title: Network checks and a clear hand-off
new.text: The install checks name resolution first, prints exactly what your network team must set up, and resumes where it stopped. A final check proves everything works from inside the network.

new.title: Move an existing install to private
new.text: An existing public install moves to the private network with the same command, and you can preview the plan first.
